lines.cn: 三千年前，太湖以东，一片水网还没有名字。
lines.en: Three thousand years ago, east of Lake Tai, this waterland had no name.

lines.cn: 水，是这座城最早的一道年轮。
lines.en: Water was the first ring of this city.

lines.cn: 公元前五百一十四年，伍子胥相土尝水，筑起阖闾大城。
lines.en: In 514 BC, Wu Zixu read the land and water, and built the great city of Helü.

lines.cn: 八座水陆城门，墙内三横四直；河道与街巷，并肩而行。
lines.en: Eight water-and-land gates; inside, canals and streets ran side by side.

lines.cn: 秦置会稽郡，吴县为治所，江南的稻米，开始沿着水运北上。
lines.en: Under the Qin, Kuaiji Commandery ruled from Wu County; Jiangnan rice began moving north by water.

lines.cn: 隋开皇九年，因姑苏山得名——从此，它叫苏州。
lines.en: In 589, it took its name from Mount Gusu: Suzhou.

lines.cn: 唐宝历元年，白居易出任苏州刺史，开凿了七里山塘。
lines.en: In 825, Bai Juyi became governor of Suzhou and cut the Seven-Li Shantang.

lines.cn: 南宋的《平江图》上，刻下的是一座水陆双棋盘的城市——一河一街，一桥一巷。
lines.en: The Pingjiang Map of the Southern Song records a city of two chessboards — water and street, bridge and lane.

lines.cn: 到了明清，园林、丝织与状元，把苏州的繁华写进巷子深处。
lines.en: By Ming and Qing, gardens, silk and scholars wrote Suzhou's prosperity deep into its lanes.

lines.cn: 清代的姑苏，商船沿运河昼夜往来，烟火一直铺向四方。
lines.en: In the Qing, boats moved along the Grand Canal day and night, and Gusu's life spread far.

lines.cn: 一八九六年，苏州开埠；城墙外的世界，第一次靠得这么近。
lines.en: In 1896, Suzhou opened to foreign trade; the world outside the walls came close.

lines.cn: 一九九四年，金鸡湖畔打下第一根桩。
lines.en: In 1994, the first pile was driven by Jinji Lake.

lines.cn: 城墙早已消失，年轮还在一圈圈生长。
lines.en: The walls are gone, yet the rings keep growing.
